summary: Part 2 of the 8.0 Warranties - Issues (Seller & KAMs) training (03:29 to 06:37). The trainer walks through the seller side of an invalid warranty claim: marking a claim invalid with reason and proof, Revibe review (agree, challenge, or Care+ misuse route), the lab step (UAE only), the lab outcome (refund or closed), the Revibe Care+ quotation and repair routes, and cancelled or reopened claims. All 35 frames were opened (t00209 to t00396). Four example claims are used: NUVE086, MJSX592, VKDD197 and UXEQ435. Main ASR corrections: 'Revive' is Revibe, 'QuickUp' is Quiqup, 'ReviveCare Plus' is Revibe Care+ (RC+), and 'canceled' is shown as Cancelled.

terms.meaning: Status shown on the claim page that the customer sees, for example Under QC or Ready for refund (narration and screen).
Revibe's internal status for the claim, for example Invalid claim, Pending LAB collection, Seller quotation, Quotation review (narration: the internal stage differs from what the customer sees).
Field on the Statuses panel showing the seller's or agent's verdict: Invalid claim or Not replied are both shown on screen. Its meaning beyond that is not defined in the material.
Countdown bar on the claim page (8 days left in every recorded frame). Shows (paused) on some screens.
Stage after Revibe challenges an invalid claim; the seller must mark Valid or Invalid again with more proof.
Customer-facing stage after Revibe agrees with the seller's invalid claim, before lab collection.
Internal stage before the device is handed to Quiqup for the lab (in the lab collection column marked AE only).

Screen labels on the lab slide: 'Lab collection (AE only)' and 'OUTSIDE AE'. The screen does not spell out the code, but the caption 'Lab check: UAE only' appears on the same slide. Outside AE has no lab and the agent's confirmation is final.
AWB auto-created for the lab collection on the Quiqup side; the seller hands the device to Quiqup. The screen does not expand the AWB abbreviation.
Screen label for the markets where a lab-invalid device is returned at the customer's cost. Narration names them as Saudi Arabia and South Africa.
Stage after a lab-valid decision; the customer is refunded.
Revibe's extended warranty covering the repair for the customer; the repairer gives a quotation, Revibe approves it and pays.
Agent marking for a misuse claim where the customer has Revibe Care+. Leads to the seller quotation (Route A).
Repairer used after 1 year or when misuse is declared. The original seller does not see the claim.

terms.term: Seller quotation / Seller quotation review / Quotation review
terms.meaning: Seller quotation: the repairer enters the repair price. Seller quotation review: the Revibe agent approves (Yes → repair) or sends it back (No → back to quotation). Quotation review is the internal stage after the seller quotes.
Financial Summary field holding the seller's repair price.
Outcome where no repair is done and the device goes back to the customer as is.
Closed outcome after refusal; also the outcome when a ship-back is refused.
Stage a reopened claim returns to; the claim is active again.

unclear.issue: The narration says 'or the customer has ReviveCare Plus' (04:11 to 04:16) without the misuse condition. The screen only shows the RC+ branch as 'Misuse but customer has RC+ → seller quotation'. It is unclear whether an RC+ customer alone (no misuse) leads to a seller quotation.

The narration says the reason, comment and proof appear in the claim details. The comment typed on the form at 03:45 was 'ABCD', but the claim details for the same claim show Proof Of Invalid Claim 'Impact damage on the screen corner, not a manufacturing fault' and no 'ABCD'. The screens do not show whether the form comment is stored in the claim.

The narration says 'your policy timer keeps running'. The timer shows '(paused)' on some claim screens and not on the Under revision, Expert revision or Seller quotation screens. The narration does not explain why.

The narration says 'The agent's decision is final.' with no scope. The screen limits the finality to 'OUTSIDE AE: No Lab yet: the agent's confirmation of the seller's Invalid is final.' It is unclear whether the agent's decision is also final for AE claims that go to the lab.

Narration says 'The lab check is in the UAE only' (04:39) and then 'it travels to the lab outside the UAE' (04:42). The screen shows 'Lab check: UAE only' and 'Lab collection (AE only)' but does not say where the lab is. The location of the lab is unclear.

Narration says 'If they refuse or don't reply'. It is unclear who 'they' is (customer or another party). The screen only shows the caption 'Refused → Device disposed, claim closed' and nothing about no reply.
An Edit page is shown for claim NUVE086 with breadcrumb 'Dashboard • Claims • Details • 123325', which does not match the claim ID NUVE086. The narration does not say what was edited or why.
On the Ready for refund claim MJSX592 the Valid Claim? field still reads 'Invalid claim'. The narration does not explain whether this is expected.
The Financial Summary frame (t00342) does not show a claim number. It is placed after the VKDD197 frames and the 2000 value is attributed to VKDD197 on that basis.
Narration says 'Revive can reopen it'. It is not shown whether a seller can reopen a cancelled claim or only Revibe can.

Frame t00231 shows the action buttons 'Cancel override' and 'Validate address' drawn in a highlighted purple style, plus the Tracker button; neither is narrated. Their purpose is not explained in the material.
